.@elonmusk on Grok 4.7: "A solid workhorse of a model."

"We've only been around for about three years doing AI, whereas Anthropic's been around for six years. So I would expect that we probably catch up to frontier sometime next year, most likely."

.@elonmusk on why full rocket reuse matters. Not recovering the upper stage "is like throwing away a medium-sized jet on every flight."

"If you had to throw away the planes after every flight, it would be far too expensive, and air flight would not be a realistic option." 🚀

🎥 CGTN / CMG interview

Video

.@elonmusk on where Grok can win:

"What Anthropic did extremely well was make AI excellent at software engineering, but no one has yet made AI excellent at real-world engineering."

"I think that's an opportunity for Grok, using the training data from SpaceX and Tesla." 🚀

🎥 CGTN / CMG interview

Video

.@elonmusk on Cybercab's look:

"We designed the car to look futuristic… from a fashion standpoint, we don't want the aesthetics of the street to stay stagnant."

"Probably time to make things look more futuristic." 🚕

🎥 CGTN / CMG interview

.@elonmusk on why robots will out-react humans:

"We are somewhat constrained by our biology. But a robot, you can just improve the actuators, improve the sensors, improve the frame rate of the cameras… and it's going to just fundamentally be much better and have faster reactions than humans." 🤖

🎥 CGTN / CMG interview

JUST IN: @elonmusk on why Neuralink matters

Humans get information out far more slowly than AI does.

"Talking to a human will be like talking to a tree. You talk to a tree, it takes a long time to respond."

Video

JUST IN: @elonmusk on why we go multiplanetary

The first reason is defense. Becoming multiplanetary is "life insurance for life as a whole."

The second is inspiration. "Life cannot just be about solving one sad problem after another. There must also be things that make you excited to wake up in the morning."
